name: opensre
description: The open-source agent for CI/CD reliability.
one_liner: An AI agent that reads your failed automated-build logs and explains what actually broke and how to fix it, instead of leaving engineers to dig through logs themselves.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size company whose team loses hours every week debugging flaky or broken CI pipelines.
business_use_cases: An engineering team wires it into their CI so every failed build gets an automatic root-cause explanation posted to the pull request.
A DevOps consultancy offers 'CI reliability as a service' to clients, powered by this agent, cutting their clients' mean-time-to-fix.
A platform team uses it to triage flaky tests across dozens of repos without a dedicated reliability engineer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed/hosted version with alerting and dashboards as a subscription for teams who don't want to self-host it.
Sell CI-reliability consulting engagements that use it as the diagnostic engine.

steal_this: Wire it into the CI of three local startups' repos this weekend as a free trial, then convert them to a paid monthly 'CI health' subscription.
